Upon approval, an immediate checkout block will activate, stores will pull stock within 60 minutes, and affected online customers will be notified within 30 minutes.

- pull at 14 stores (212 units on hand): S033, S012, S058, S004, S052, S023, S070, S015, S030, S047, S007, S041, S063, S021
- message 37 online orders
- checkout block: yes
- supplier notice
- vendor case

A fictional retailer and fictional products. Nothing is sent and no stock moves.

**Morrowdale Vanilla Yoghurt 1kg, batch B2026-091, Listeria contamination, 14 stores, 37 online orders** (severity critical)

Morrowdale Dairy Co has issued a recall for Morrowdale Vanilla Yoghurt 1kg batch B2026-091 due to potential microbial contamination from Listeria monocytogenes. The catalogue match was confirmed via embedding match with high confidence. Lineage data confirms 14 stores currently hold 212 units on hand, and 37 online orders were fulfilled from this batch within the last 30 days. Upon approval, an immediate checkout block will activate, stores will pull stock within 60 minutes, and affected online customers will be notified within 30 minutes.

Proposed actions:
- pull at 14 stores (212 units on hand): S033, S012, S058, S004, S052, S023, S070, S015, S030, S047, S007, S041, S063, S021
- message 37 online orders
- checkout block: yes
- supplier notice
- vendor case

Evidence:
- Regulator notice 'FICTIONAL TEST: Morrowdale Vanilla Yoghurt 1kg' published 2026-10-15 (https://example.test/notices/yoghurt-listeria)
- Notice identifies microbial contamination: Listeria monocytogenes
- Affected batch code: B2026-091 (best before 2026-10-30)
- Catalogue match confirmed via embedding distance 0.08
- 14 stores get a pull, holding 212 units on hand between them; 37 online orders are messaged (receipt rcpt-fixture-yoghurt-0001)

Customer message: Recall: Morrowdale Vanilla Yoghurt 1kg
CalmChaosRetail is recalling Morrowdale Vanilla Yoghurt 1kg. Look for batch code B2026-091 and best-before date 2026-10-30 printed on the tub.

This batch may be contaminated with Listeria bacteria. Do not eat it.

Please return the product to any CalmChaosRetail store for a full refund, with no receipt needed, or keep it aside and contact us.

If you have eaten this product and feel unwell, please see your doctor.

Marlowe & Pike has issued a recall for Organic Ginger Nut Biscuits 250g, batch B2026-632, due to undeclared peanut. The catalogue match to product P10012 is confirmed via embedding match. A total of 214 units are currently on hand across 15 stores, and 2 online orders have been placed for this batch. - message 2 online orders

Please return the product to any CalmChaosRetail store for a full refund, no receipt needed, or keep it aside and contact us.

Anyone who feels unwell after eating this product should consult their doctor.

- vendor case

**Kestrel Home Essentials Brushed Steel Toaster 4 slice, batch L2026-6250: electrical fire hazard (23 stores, 5 online orders)** (severity critical)

Kestrel Home has recalled the Essentials Brushed Steel Toaster 4 slice, batch L2026-6250, due to an internal wiring fault that presents an electrical fire hazard. Catalogue matching is confirmed via embedding match. Currently, 23 stores get a pull, holding 49 units on hand between them; 5 online orders are messaged (receipt rcpt-fixture-eval-electrical-fire). Upon approval, an immediate checkout block is placed, store pulls will clear shelves within 60 minutes, and affected online customers will be notified within 30 minutes.

Proposed actions:
- pull at 23 stores (49 units on hand): S062, S042, S090, S028, S049, S054, S078, S082, S035, S045, S079, S107, S002, S014, S019, S023, S033, S072, S113, S018, S031, S043, S046
- message 5 online orders
- checkout block: yes
- supplier notice
- vendor case

Considerations:
- Stores S018, S031, S043, and S046 currently show 0 units on hand, but are assigned pull actions because they received stock from the affected batch within the past 30 days.

- Notice title: FICTIONAL TEST: Kestrel Home Essentials Brushed Steel Toaster 4 slice (published 2026-10-16)
- Notice URL: https://example.test/notices/eval-electrical-fire
- Affected batch code named in notice: L2026-6250
- Match method: embedding (distance 0.1, confirmed)
- 23 stores get a pull, holding 49 units on hand between them; 5 online orders are messaged (receipt rcpt-fixture-eval-electrical-fire)

Customer message: Recall: Kestrel Home Essentials Toaster 4 slice
Kestrel Home is recalling the Essentials Brushed Steel Toaster (4 slice) with batch code L2026-6250 printed on the base. The product has an internal wiring fault that can overheat and cause an electrical fire. Stop using it and unplug it; do not try to repair it. Please return it to any CalmChaosRetail store for a full refund, no receipt needed, or keep it aside and contact us. Anyone unwell or hurt after using it should see their doctor.

Attestation receipts: rcpt-fixture-eval-electrical-fire

The product was matched to catalogue item P11647 with high confidence via embedding search. Toddlewick has recalled its Light-Up Dinosaur toy due to a detachable horn that presents a choking hazard for young children. Catalogue matching confirmed the affected product with high confidence via embedding. Currently, 9 stores hold 39 units on hand between them, and 12 online orders were placed within 30 days. Upon coordinator approval, stock pulls across all 9 stores will execute within 60 minutes, a checkout block will activate immediately, and the 12 online customers will be messaged within 30 minutes.

Take it away from children now. Return it to any CalmChaosRetail store for a full refund, no receipt needed, or keep it aside and contact us. Anyone unwell or hurt after using it should see their doctor.
